name: Tactical Cyan Player Glow
purpose: Give cinematic esports sci-fi accent to hero player entry or weapon reload.
required_visual_conditions: Hero character occupying central vertical third of frame.
required_masks_or_mattes: Tracked circular power window or subject mask.
recommended_color_palette: Cyber cyan (#06b6d4) with electric blue falloff (#0284c7).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> LumaKeyer1 -> ColorCorrector1 (Hue: 195, Tint: Cyan) -> SoftGlow1 (Threshold: 0.5, Gain: 1.4) -> Merge1 (Screen) -> MediaOut1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: LumaKeyer extracts bright highlights on player armor, ColorCorrector tints to cyan, SoftGlow adds optical aura.
required_plugins: Native Fusion Built-in / Glow Expo optional
qa_procedure: Check that cyan color does not corrupt hero weapon skin colors; mask out the hands if skin accuracy is required.
